## Chapitre 4
```{r}
# Modele Green frog 
dataT <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c(SR, NR, OR), scale))
modele_GF <- glmer(
  Green.frogs ~  SR+NR+TR+VR+SUR1+SUR2+SUR3+UR+FR+OR+RR+BR+MR+CR+(1 | ID), 
  data = dataT, 
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
summary(modele_GF)
```
